commits.message:
Add expandable inline sub-pathway for branch nodes in SkillPathway

- Each branch card in the fork lane now shows a ▸/▾ expand toggle when the branch skill has its own companions
- Expanding reveals the branch's downstream chain (up to 5 steps) inline below the fork lane, using a teal-tinted, steel-bordered sub-track to distinguish it from the primary chain
- Collapsing restores the compact fork lane
- Added buildForwardPath() to search.ts — walks forward from an arbitrary skill root without backward root-finding, used for sub-pathway computation
- Hint text updated to mention the ▸ toggle
- SkillPathway now accepts allSkills prop passed through from SkillDetail

commits.message:
Add workflow pathway visualization to skill detail pages

- Add buildWorkflowPath() to search.ts: traverses companion graph backward to chain root then forward, returning ordered PathNode[] with branch counts
- New SkillPathway component renders the chain as a scrollable horizontal track with numbered nodes, directional arrows, and branch indicators (+N pills)
- SkillDetail replaces flat companions list with SkillPathway when a multi-step chain is available; falls back to original flat list for single isolated companions
- CSS: full pathway layout including maturity colour coding, current-skill highlight, and responsive vertical stack on narrow screens
- Restore deploy-pages.yml to correct 37f966d version (fixes broken catalog path ./src/data → ./public/data, restores all family triggers, activity feed, and test-catalog steps reverted by 7ac8267)
